ideas.pitch: A hybrid quantum-classical web application that uses Qiskit's VQE (Variational Quantum Eigensolver) to optimize liquidity pool distributions across decentralized finance protocols for maximum risk-adjusted return.
ideas.title: Quantum Portfolio Optimizer for DeFi Yields
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies Qiskit optimization algorithms to a high-value real-world financial domain, perfectly aligning with the IBM Quantum ecosystem focus.

ideas.pitch: A quantum machine learning pipeline utilizing parameterized quantum circuits via Qiskit Machine Learning to classify molecular toxicity far faster than classical deep learning models on small datasets.
ideas.title: QML-Driven Drug Toxicity Screening
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages Quantum Neural Networks and QML, hitting the exact technical evaluation vectors highlighted in the hackathon's focus areas.

ideas.pitch: A developer utility dashboard that visualizes quantum circuit noise and applies automated measurement error mitigation routines using Qiskit Aer simulations and IBM runtime primitives.
ideas.title: Entangled State Error Mitigation Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the most prominent engineering bottleneck in near-term quantum computing (NISQ era noise), showcasing hard systems-level engineering.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise logistics dashboard that solves the Vehicle Routing Problem by offloading combinatorial optimization subproblems to Qiskit's QAOA algorithm while handling constraints classically.
ideas.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Supply Chain Routing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Translates abstract quantum algorithms into an enterprise-ready dashboard application with clear commercial utility.

ideas.pitch: An educational drag-and-drop web IDE that compiles visual quantum gate arrangements into optimized Qiskit Python code and simulates statevector evolution in real-time.
ideas.title: Quantum Circuit Synthesis Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals strongly to university judges and organizers who prioritize developer tooling and onboarding tools for new quantum computing students.
